disclosure_intro.message: Perchling works inside your YouTube and YouTube Music tabs, as the account you're signed in to there. For the features you switch on, it:

disclosure_bullet_1.message: [[strong]]reads what you watch and listen to there:[[/strong]] the video or song, its channel, and how much of it you've played;
disclosure_bullet_1.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_2.message: [[strong]]reads and changes your playlists, as you:[[/strong]] it lists them, checks which ones already hold a video, and adds or removes videos when you ask, or when auto-add or automatic gathering does, using YouTube's own requests;
disclosure_bullet_2.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_3.message: [[strong]]reads the YouTube tabs open in a window when you gather them,[[/strong]] or when automatic gathering does: their addresses and titles, to collect their videos. It closes those tabs only if you've asked it to;
disclosure_bullet_3.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_4.message: [[strong]]signs those requests the way YouTube's page does,[[/strong]] with YouTube's sign-in cookie, inside the YouTube tab. It never stores that cookie or sends it anywhere else;
disclosure_bullet_4.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_5.message: [[strong]]watches for the shortcut keys you set[[/strong]] on YouTube and YouTube Music pages, and ignores every other key. Keys you set in your browser for Keys from any tab are caught by the browser itself;
disclosure_bullet_5.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_bullet_6.message: [[strong]]keeps its settings in this browser,[[/strong]] including your account's name, @handle and picture, a list of your playlists, and how much of each video you've watched (for up to 30 days).
disclosure_bullet_6.description: A complete message. The [[strong]] and [[/strong]] markers select emphasis and render as escaped text.

disclosure_closing_chrome.message: Nothing is sent to us or to anyone but YouTube. There are no ads and no analytics. If you turn on Settings sync, your settings also travel through Chrome's own sync.

disclosure_closing_firefox.message: Nothing is sent to us or to anyone but YouTube. There are no ads and no analytics. If you turn on Settings sync, your settings also travel through Firefox's own sync.

feature_description_11.message: Keys you set in your browser to save or like the playing song, or save the current video to Watch later, from any tab.

feature_description_10.message: A key for each quick action. It acts on the song you're pointing at, else the one playing.

feature_description_9.message: Play next, Add to queue and more, one click away on songs, albums and playlists.

feature_description_8.message: Gathers the YouTube videos open in a window into one list or a playlist, and can close their tabs. It can also do it by itself.

feature_description_7.message: Adds Save to ▸ to the browser's own right-click menu on videos, so YouTube's page stays as it is.

feature_description_6.message: Right-clicking a video opens YouTube's own ⋮ menu. Hold Shift for the browser's menu.

feature_description_5.message: A button in YouTube's row under the video, before Save, that shows auto-add's status, with Save to…, Don't auto-add this video and this channel's filter.

feature_description_4.message: A button on thumbnails that adds the video to the end of the queue.

feature_description_3.message: A save button on thumbnails: one click saves to your quick-save playlist, and ▾ picks another.

feature_description_2.message: Keys that save the video you're pointing at or watching. Alt+W saves to Watch later.

feature_description_1.message: Adds the videos you watch to your chosen playlists once you've watched enough of them.

footprintText_keys.message: Keys only, doesn't change the page

feature_sync_chrome.message: Brings your settings to your other browsers through Chrome's own sync.

feature_sync_firefox.message: Brings your settings to your other browsers through Firefox's own sync.

copy_missingPlaylist.message: a playlist that's no longer available
